CLAIM | "a probe that failed to start, times out, returns unparseable output, or cannot import daedalus at all reports ok=False" | check_import_provenance | BROKEN | The docstring claims "cannot import daedalus at all" reports ok=False, but the code returns ok=False only when raw.get('import_error') is truthy; if daedalus is not importable but no exception is raised (e.g., the import succeeds but daedalus is a module without __file__ and __path__ is empty), the code proceeds to check _under with candidates that are all None/empty, and returns ok=False only if none of them is under root. In that case the reason says "resolves OUTSIDE the candidate tree" rather than "cannot import", contradicting the claim that import failure always yields ok=False with a distinct reason. Line: check_import_provenance, after raw = json.loads(...).
todos: Change the docstring to reflect that import failure is only one possible cause of ok=False, or adjust the code to explicitly check for missing daedalus even when no exception occurred.
